title: Odd time signatures in clinics
summary: He gets too little chance to play odd times and addresses them in clinics.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Do you get to play in odd time signatures at all?
Not enough. I love to do it. I love to do it. When I perform a clinic, I address the odd time issue as much as I can. They’re not danceable.
